context: Stage 2 of the staged community-feature build the user agreed to: 1:1 direct messages, built on top of v37's login/presence foundation.

what_was_built.schema: New direct_messages table (id, sender_id, recipient_id, body, created_at, read_at) -- completely separate from any future group/community chat table, per the request. Indexes on (recipient_id, read_at) for the unread-count query and (sender_id, recipient_id, created_at) for fetching a thread.
backend: functions/api/dm/send.js -- POST {senderId, recipientId, body}, validates and inserts a message.
functions/api/dm/thread.js -- GET ?userId=&otherId=, returns the full conversation between two users in chronological order.
functions/api/dm/read.js -- POST {userId, otherId}, marks all unread messages FROM otherId TO userId as read.

functions/api/presence/heartbeat.js (modified) -- now also returns an unreadDms array (sender id, nickname, count) alongside the existing last_seen_at update, so the unread-message check piggybacks on the same 20-second heartbeat cycle instead of needing a separate poll, matching the requested design.
frontend: message button added next to each user in the online-users list, opening a 1:1 chat window with that person.
Chat window: KakaoTalk-style bubbles -- my messages right-aligned in purple, the other person's left-aligned in gray. Message input + send button (Enter key also sends).
Opening a chat window automatically marks that person's messages as read (calls /api/dm/read) and clears the local unread-tracking entry for them.

Bell notification integration: the client compares each heartbeat's unread counts per sender against what it saw last time -- only a genuine increase triggers a notification, preventing re-notifying every 20s for the same still-unread messages. A new notification entry is added and the bell starts shaking/ringing.
The bell stops ringing the moment either the notification panel is opened, or a chat thread is opened (whether via the notification item or the message button directly).

Notification items for incoming DMs are clickable and open the correct chat thread directly; existing system notifications (level-up, mission complete) are unchanged and still don't trigger the bell ring.

explicitly_not_included_yet: user search and searching offline users
starting a conversation with someone who is currently offline

verification.syntax: node --check passes on game.js and all 4 new/modified backend files.
verification.send_flow: Verified via a page-injected window.fetch override that opening a chat, sending a message, and having it appear as a right-aligned purple bubble all worked correctly.
verification.notification_flow_with_real_timer: Logged in, then waited for the actual 20-second heartbeat interval to fire naturally with a mocked response reporting 2 unread messages from a new sender. Confirmed the bell started ringing and the badge showed the count; opening the notification panel stopped the ringing; the DM notification item was clickable and opened the correct person's chat thread.
verification.existing_regression_suite_rerun: JS syntax check, road-graph integrity, the stuck-at-node escape test, the speed-equalization test, and the standard headless-browser playthrough all still pass.

deployment_note_important: schema.sql needs to be re-applied to the project's D1 database for the new direct_messages table to exist, otherwise all three dm endpoints will fail.
